{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dome of the [[Mother Jungle/Legends|Mother Jungle]]''' was served as the center of every [[Ithorian Herdship]]. The dome was a large chamber dominating the lower sections of the ship, and was protected by a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome. Inside the dome was a transplanted piece of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] sacred jungle, presided over by the dutiful Ithorians who traveled aboard the herdship.
